c: Shred cabbage finely; grate carrots on the coarse side.
Rub cabbage with salt and sugar 1–2 min until it softens.
Add carrots, oil, vinegar and chopped dill; mix. Rest 15 min at 0–4 °C before service.
a8240952.st: Shredded vegetables: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Dressed salad: 0–4 °C, 24 h.

c: Tomatoes in wedges, cucumber in half-moons, peppers and onion in thin rings.
Season vegetables with salt, oil and vinegar just before service.
Top with feta in 2 cm cubes or slices, olives and oregano. Serve at 0–5 °C.
89171863.st: Cut vegetables (undressed): 0–4 °C, 12 h. Dressed salad: serve within 2 h.

c: Cook fusilli in salted boiling water al dente, 9–10 min; drain, toss with 20 g oil, cool fast to \< 5 °C.
Halve tomatoes and mozzarella balls (or 1.5 cm dice); dice cucumber and pepper 1 cm; slice onion and olives.
Whisk remaining oil, vinegar, oregano, salt and pepper.
Mix all, add torn basil at service. Serve at 0–5 °C.
d7ff1c4f.st: Cooked pasta: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Dressed salad: 0–4 °C, 24 h.

c: Wash leaves in cold water, spin dry, keep chilled.
Halve tomatoes, slice cucumber; crumble feta.
Whisk oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper; dress leaves only at service, feta on top.
1a67fbe8.st: Washed leaves: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Dressed salad: serve within 1 h.

c: Boil potatoes in skins in salted water until just tender, 25–30 min; peel warm, cut in 1.5 cm dice.
Slice onion thinly, rub with 1 g salt; chop parsley.
Dress the warm potatoes with oil, vinegar, salt and pepper; fold in onion and parsley.
Cool to \< 5 °C within 2 h. Serve chilled.
dfdfcf39.st: Boiled potatoes: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Dressed salad: 0–4 °C, 24 h.

c: Peppers roasted at 220 °C, 15–20 min, peeled and cut in strips (or raw, diced).
Dice tomatoes and cucumbers 1.5 cm; chop onion and parsley.
Season with salt, oil and vinegar just before service.
Grate sirene generously on top. Serve at 0–5 °C.
253db3c8.st: Cut vegetables (undressed): 0–4 °C, 12 h. Dressed salad: serve within 2 h.

c: Batch · Yield ≈ 1000 g drained (1 × 3 L jar)
Cabbage in 4 cm wedges, cauliflower in small florets, peppers in rings, carrots in 0.5 cm slices, garlic halved.
Pack vegetables tightly in a clean jar with garlic, peppercorns and bay leaf.
Boil water, salt and sugar; take off heat, add vinegar and pour hot over the vegetables to cover.
Seal, cool, keep at 0–4 °C; ready after 5–7 days. Serve drained, well chilled.
eb768687.st: Sealed jar: 0–4 °C, 6 weeks. Opened: 0–4 °C, 7 days, vegetables always under brine.

c: Soak beans 8–12 h in cold water; drain. Boil 5 min, drain again.
Cover with fresh water, add bay leaf, simmer 60–80 min until soft.
Sauté diced onion, carrot and pepper in oil 5 min; stir in paprika and tomatoes; add to the beans.
Simmer 15 min; season with salt, mint and savory; add parsley. Hold ≥ 63 °C.
3f0725af.st: Cooked beans: 0–4 °C, 72 h. Finished soup: 0–4 °C, 72 h; reheat to ≥ 75 °C.

c: Cut beef in 1.5 cm dice; cover with cold water, boil, skim; simmer with bay leaf 75–90 min until tender, top up water. Core ≥ 75 °C.
Sauté diced onion, carrot, celery and pepper in oil 5 min; stir in paprika and tomatoes.
Add vegetables and diced potatoes to the beef; simmer 20 min. Season, add parsley. Hold ≥ 63 °C.
f11ae6f2.st: Boiled beef and broth: 0–4 °C, 72 h. Finished soup: 0–4 °C, 72 h; reheat to ≥ 75 °C.

1a6c74fb.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 300 g + 20 g garlic vinegar
c: Rinse tripe; cover with cold water, boil, discard water.
Simmer in fresh water 2–2½ h until tender, core ≥ 75 °C; cut in 1 × 3 cm strips, keep the liquid.
Return tripe to 1.8 L of the liquid, add milk; bring to a simmer.
Warm oil, stir in paprika off the heat, add to the soup; season. Hold ≥ 63 °C.
Crush garlic, mix with vinegar and water. Serve on the side with chilli flakes.
1a6c74fb.st: Boiled tripe: 0–4 °C, 72 h. Finished soup: 0–4 °C, 48 h; reheat to ≥ 75 °C. Garlic vinegar: 0–4 °C, 72 h.

c: Cover chicken with cold water, bring to the boil, skim; simmer 50 min, core ≥ 75 °C. Strain stock, debone and shred meat.
Sweat diced carrot, onion and celery in butter 5 min; add stock, simmer 15 min.
Add vermicelli and chicken, cook 6–8 min.
Liaison: whisk eggs, yoghurt and lemon juice, temper with hot stock, stir in off the boil (≤ 80 °C). Season, add parsley. Hold ≥ 63 °C.
6c0bf120.st: Stock and meat: 0–4 °C, 72 h. Finished soup: 0–4 °C, 48 h; reheat gently to ≥ 75 °C, do not boil.
6c0bf120.al: 1 Gluten (vermicelli) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (yoghurt 3.6%, butter) · 9 Celery (celery stalk)

c: Sweat sliced onion and garlic in butter 5 min; add sliced mushrooms, cook on high heat 8–10 min until liquid evaporates.
Add diced potatoes, stock and thyme; simmer 20 min.
Blend smooth, add cream, bring back to a simmer; season. Garnish with parsley. Hold ≥ 63 °C.
e36383e9.al: 7 Milk (cream 20%, butter) · 9 Celery (vegetable stock). Stock: check label.

c: Cut lamb in 1.5 cm dice; cover with cold water, boil, skim; simmer 60 min until tender; core ≥ 75 °C.
Sweat diced onion, carrot and spring onion in butter 5 min, stir in paprika; add to the lamb.
Add rinsed rice; simmer 15 min. Season with salt, pepper and mint.
Liaison: eggs + yoghurt tempered with hot broth, stir in off the boil (≤ 80 °C); add parsley. Hold ≥ 63 °C.
69687d7b.st: Boiled lamb and broth: 0–4 °C, 72 h. Finished soup: 0–4 °C, 48 h; reheat gently to ≥ 75 °C.

c: Rinse lentils; bring to the boil in water with bay leaf, simmer 15 min.
Sauté diced onion, carrot and garlic in oil 5 min; off heat stir in paprika, add tomatoes.
Add to lentils; simmer 20–25 min until soft. Season with salt and savory. Hold ≥ 63 °C.
Sauté diced onion, carrot and pepper in oil 5 min; stir in paprika and tomato paste 1 min.
Add water and potatoes in 1.5 cm dice; simmer 20–25 min until soft.
Season with salt, pepper and savory; add parsley. Hold ≥ 63 °C.
Sweat diced onion, carrot and garlic in butter 5 min; dust with flour, cook 1 min.
Add water gradually, whisking; add rice and simmer 12 min.
Add spinach (thawed, chopped); simmer 8 min. Season.
Liaison: eggs + yoghurt tempered with hot soup, stir in off the boil (≤ 80 °C). Hold ≥ 63 °C.
56480174.st: Finished soup: 0–4 °C, 48 h; reheat gently to ≥ 75 °C, do not boil.

c: Peel cucumbers if bitter; dice 0.5 cm or grate coarsely.
Whisk yoghurt with cold water until smooth; add crushed garlic, salt and oil.
Add cucumber and chopped dill; chill ≥ 1 h. Serve at 0–5 °C, crushed walnuts on top.
353f6938.al: 7 Milk (yoghurt 3.6%) · 8 Nuts (walnuts). Walnuts can be served on the side for nut-free portions.

23f26f84.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 390 g (fish 150 g, mash 200 g, sauce 40 g)
c: Thaw fillets at 0–4 °C, pat dry; cut 10 portions, season with salt, pepper and lemon.
Coat in flour, beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Deep-fry at 170–175 °C, 4–5 min until golden; core ≥ 63 °C. Drain on paper; hold ≥ 63 °C, max 30 min.
Chop gherkins and herbs finely; mix with mayonnaise, yoghurt and lemon juice. Keep at 0–4 °C.
Boil peeled potatoes in salted water 20–25 min; drain and steam-dry 2 min.
Mash with hot milk and butter until smooth; season. Hold ≥ 63 °C.
Mash on the plate, fish beside it, tartare sauce in a ramekin or on the side; lemon wedge optional.
23f26f84.st: Breaded raw fish: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Fried fish: serve, do not reheat. Tartare sauce: 0–4 °C, 72 h. Mash: 0–4 °C, 48 h; reheat to ≥ 75 °C.
23f26f84.al: 1 Gluten (breadcrumbs, wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs, mayonnaise) · 4 Fish (hake fillet) · 7 Milk (yoghurt 3.6%, milk 3%, butter). Mayonnaise: check label (10 Mustard may be present).

c2db9291.yl: Yield: 10 portions (1 GN 1/1, 65 mm) · Portion: 350 g
c: Fry chopped onion in oil 5 min; add mince, brown 8–10 min, breaking it up.
Add paprika, tomatoes, salt, pepper and savory; cook 5 min.
Peel potatoes, cut in 1.5 cm dice; mix with the mince and parsley; spread in an oiled GN tray.
Pour water over; bake at 180 °C, 45–50 min until potatoes are soft.
Whisk eggs with flour until smooth, then whisk in yoghurt and salt.
Pour topping evenly over the hot base.
Bake at 200 °C, 15–20 min until set and golden; core ≥ 75 °C.
c2db9291.st: Baked moussaka: 0–4 °C, 72 h; reheat covered at 160 °C to ≥ 75 °C core.

dcc7d174.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 390 g (fricassee 240 g, rice 150 g)
c: Cut chicken in 3 cm pieces; season. Seal in butter without colouring, 4–5 min; remove.
Sweat diced onion and carrot in the same pan 5 min; dust with flour, cook 1 min.
Add hot stock, whisking; return chicken with bay leaf, simmer covered 20 min.
Add peas and cream, simmer 5 min; core ≥ 75 °C. Finish with lemon juice, parsley; season. Hold ≥ 63 °C.
Rinse rice until water runs clear.
Bring water and salt to the boil, add rice; cover and simmer on low heat 15 min (or combi steamer 100 °C, 25 min in perforated GN with water 1:2).
Rest covered 5 min, fork in butter. Hold ≥ 63 °C.
Rice moulded on the plate, fricassee beside it with its sauce.
dcc7d174.st: Fricassee: 0–4 °C, 48 h; reheat to ≥ 75 °C. Rice: cool \< 5 °C within 90 min, 0–4 °C, 24 h; reheat once to ≥ 75 °C.
dcc7d174.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 7 Milk (cream 20%, butter) · 9 Celery (chicken stock). Stock: check label.

bf5f3df0.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 370 g (julienne 220 g, rice 150 g)
c: Cut chicken in 1 × 5 cm strips; season. Sear in hot oil in batches 3–4 min; remove.
Sauté sliced onion and mushrooms 6–8 min; dust with flour and paprika, cook 1 min.
Add stock and cream, simmer 3 min; return chicken and gherkin strips, simmer 5 min; core ≥ 75 °C.
Rinse rice until water runs clear.
Bring water and salt to the boil, add rice; cover and simmer on low heat 15 min (or combi steamer 100 °C, 25 min in perforated GN with water 1:2).
Rest covered 5 min, fork in butter. Hold ≥ 63 °C.
Rice moulded on the plate, julienne beside it with its sauce.
bf5f3df0.st: Julienne: 0–4 °C, 48 h; reheat to ≥ 75 °C. Rice: cool \< 5 °C within 90 min, 0–4 °C, 24 h; reheat once to ≥ 75 °C.
bf5f3df0.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 7 Milk (cream 20%, butter) · 9 Celery (chicken stock). Stock: check label.

1390c0e1.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 355 g (1 kyufte 85 g, 1 kebapche 70 g, potatoes 200 g)
c: Batch · Yield ≈ 850 g grilled (10 × 110 g raw)
Soak bread in sparkling water, squeeze; grate onion, chop parsley.
Knead mince with all ingredients 3–4 min until sticky; rest ≥ 2 h at 0–4 °C.
Shape 10 flat round kyufteta of 110 g with wet hands.
Grill at 220 °C, 4–5 min per side; core ≥ 75 °C. Hold ≥ 63 °C.
Batch · Yield ≈ 700 g grilled (10 × 90 g raw)
Knead mince with salt, cumin, pepper and sparkling water 3–4 min; rest ≥ 2 h at 0–4 °C.
Shape 10 kebapcheta of 90 g, 12 cm long; brush with oil.
Grill at 220 °C, 8–10 min, turning; core ≥ 75 °C. Hold ≥ 63 °C.
Peel potatoes, cut in 2 cm dice; par-boil in salted water 6–7 min, drain and steam-dry.
Sauté in hot oil in batches until golden, 10–12 min (or roast 210 °C, 25 min).
Finish with butter, chopped garlic and parsley; season. Hold ≥ 63 °C.
One kyufte and one kebapche with the potatoes; lyutenitsa or mustard on the side on request.
1390c0e1.st: Raw mince mixes: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Grilled meat: 0–4 °C, 48 h; reheat to ≥ 75 °C. Potatoes: serve same day.

88d5b83a.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 500 g (mackerel 180 g, plakia 120 g, potatoes 200 g)
c: Batch · Yield ≈ 3000 g (fish 1800 g + sauce 1200 g, 1 GN 1/1)
Thaw mackerel at 0–4 °C; cut in 10 pieces of ≈ 200 g, season with salt and pepper.
Sweat onion in half-rings, carrot and pepper strips in oil 10 min; add garlic, paprika, tomato paste, tomatoes, water, sugar and bay leaf; simmer 10 min.
Spread sauce in a GN tray, place fish on top, lemon slices over.
Bake at 180 °C, 25–30 min; core ≥ 63 °C. Sprinkle with parsley. Hold ≥ 63 °C.
Peel potatoes, cut in even 4–5 cm pieces; boil in salted water 18–20 min.
Drain, toss with butter and chopped parsley. Hold ≥ 63 °C.
One piece of fish with sauce, potatoes beside it.
88d5b83a.st: Plakia sauce: 0–4 °C, 72 h. Baked fish: 0–4 °C, 24 h; reheat once to ≥ 75 °C. Potatoes: 0–4 °C, 24 h.
88d5b83a.al: 4 Fish (mackerel) · 7 Milk (butter). Fish pieces contain bones.

a3c21531.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 480 g (meatloaf 200 g, sauce 80 g, wedges 200 g)
c: Batch · Yield ≈ 2000 g roasted (2 rolls × 5 portions)
Hard-boil 5 of the eggs (250 g), 10 min; cool and peel. Blanch whole carrots 5 min; cut peppers in strips.
Soak bread in milk; knead mince with the bread, 2 raw eggs, grated onion, garlic, parsley, spices and salt.
Spread half of the mince on cling film 30 × 20 cm per roll; lay eggs, carrots, gherkins and peppers lengthwise; roll tightly.
Roast seam down at 180 °C, 50–60 min; core ≥ 75 °C. Rest 10 min, cut 2 slices per portion.
Brown diced onion and carrot in butter 6 min; add tomato paste and flour, cook 2 min.
Add hot stock and degreased roasting juices; simmer 15 min with bay leaf.
Wash potatoes, cut skin-on into 8 wedges; par-boil 4 min, drain and dry.
Toss with oil, paprika, crushed garlic, salt and pepper; spread on lined trays in one layer.
Roast at 210 °C, 25–30 min, turning once, until crisp. Hold ≥ 63 °C max 30 min.
Two slices of meatloaf with sauce over, wedges beside.
a3c21531.st: Raw rolls: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Roasted meatloaf: 0–4 °C, 72 h; reheat to ≥ 75 °C. Sauce: 0–4 °C, 72 h. Wedges: serve same day.
a3c21531.al: 1 Gluten (white bread, wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter) · 9 Celery (beef stock). Stock: check label.

ec3e5aa4.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 360 g (pasta 150 g, sauce 200 g, cheese 10 g)
c: Sweat finely diced onion, carrot, celery and garlic in oil 8 min.
Add mince, brown on high heat 8–10 min, breaking it up.
Add tomato paste 2 min, then passata, water, bay leaf and oregano; simmer gently 50–60 min; core ≥ 75 °C.
Season with salt, pepper and sugar. Hold ≥ 63 °C.
Cook in 6 L boiling water with 60 g salt, 10–11 min al dente; drain, toss with oil.
Hold ≥ 63 °C max 30 min, or cool quickly and regenerate in boiling water 1 min.
Pasta in the bowl, sauce on top, grated cheese over (or on the side).
ec3e5aa4.st: Sauce: 0–4 °C, 72 h; −18 °C, 3 months; reheat to ≥ 75 °C. Cooked pasta: 0–4 °C, 24 h.

8c9c6cab.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 300 g (pasta 150 g, sauce 150 g)
c: Sweat finely chopped onion in oil 6 min; add sliced garlic 1 min.
Add tomatoes and oregano; simmer 25–30 min, stirring.
Season with salt, pepper and sugar; blend lightly if desired; add torn basil. Hold ≥ 63 °C.
Cook in 6 L boiling water with 60 g salt, 10–11 min al dente; drain, toss with oil.
Pasta in the bowl, sauce on top. Grated cheese on the side on request (7 Milk).
8c9c6cab.st: Sauce: 0–4 °C, 72 h; −18 °C, 3 months; reheat to ≥ 75 °C. Cooked pasta: 0–4 °C, 24 h.

d0bf4bbf.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 390 g (chicken 190 g bone-in, pilaf 200 g)
c: Marinate legs with oil, lemon juice and zest, crushed garlic, thyme, paprika, salt and pepper ≥ 2 h at 0–4 °C.
Roast skin up on a rack at 190 °C, 40–45 min (combi 180 °C, 30 % steam, 35 min); core ≥ 75 °C.
Baste with the pan juices; rest 5 min. Hold ≥ 63 °C.
Sweat diced onion, carrot and pepper in oil 5 min; add rinsed rice, stir 2 min until glossy.
Add hot stock, paprika and salt; cover and cook on low heat or in the oven at 180 °C, 18 min.
Fold in peas, rest covered 5 min. Hold ≥ 63 °C.
Pilaf on the plate, chicken leg on top, a spoon of pan juices over.
d0bf4bbf.st: Marinated raw chicken: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Roasted chicken: 0–4 °C, 72 h; reheat to ≥ 75 °C. Pilaf: cool \< 5 °C within 90 min, 0–4 °C, 24 h.

a9ddbda0.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 540 g (knuckle 250 g bone-in, kachamak 200 g, sauce 90 g)
c: Batch · Yield ≈ 2500 g roasted, bone-in (≈ 4–5 knuckles)
Score the skin; rub with salt, pepper and garlic.
Braise covered on onion, carrot and bay leaf with water at 150 °C, 2 h (or simmer 90 min).
Uncover, brush with oil, roast at 200–210 °C, 35–40 min until skin is crisp; core ≥ 75 °C.
Rest 10 min; cut each knuckle in 2 portions. Strain the juices for the sauce.
Sauté chopped onion in butter 3 min; add sliced mushrooms, cook on high heat 8 min.
Dust with flour, cook 1 min; add stock (or degreased roasting juices) and cream, simmer 5 min.
Bring salted water to the boil; rain in corn meal, whisking constantly.
Cook on low heat, stirring, 25–30 min until thick and smooth; finish with butter. Hold ≥ 63 °C.
Kachamak on the plate, knuckle beside it, mushroom sauce over the kachamak.
a9ddbda0.st: Braised knuckle: 0–4 °C, 72 h; roast/reheat to ≥ 75 °C. Mushroom sauce: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Kachamak: 0–4 °C, 48 h; reheat with a little water.
a9ddbda0.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 7 Milk (cream 20%, butter) · 9 Celery (vegetable stock). Stock: check label.

c: Cut all vegetables in 2 cm pieces; salt the eggplant 15 min, rinse and squeeze.
Sweat onion and carrot in oil 5 min; add peppers and green beans, 5 min.
Add eggplant, zucchini, garlic, paprika, tomatoes and bay leaf; cover and stew on low heat 25–30 min.
